description:
Apply the approved message to every global and high-traffic surface.

Exit criteria:
- Global metadata, footer, hubs, and feature labels use one category.
- Global copy carries the operational-control benefit without overstating identity, audit, security, or compliance.
- Unsupported absolute claims are absent.
- Human and machine descriptions agree.
